Court No. - 27

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10176 of 2023
Applicant :- Arun
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy. Home And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Umesh Chandra Shukla,Ajeet Kumar Singh,Rakesh Kumar Tripathi,Um Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Ajeet Kumar Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Shaunak Singh,
the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
462 of 2022, under Section 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, registered at Police Station Kotwali Dehat, District Hardoi 3.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 31.08.2022 alleging that some unknown person had enticed away the complainant's minor daughter.

4. In the statement of the victim recorded by the trial court, a copy whereof has been filed along with the supplementary affidavit wherein she stated that she had gone with the applicant and he made physical relations with her against her consent but in her cross-examination, she stated that the applicant did not commit any misdeed against her.
She categorically stated that she had not given any such statement to the investigating officer.

5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Keeping in view the aforesaid statement of the victim recorded during her cross-examination,
coupled with the fact that the applicant is a young man aged 21 years old having no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since23.09.2022 and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
8. Let the applicant- Arun be released on bail in the aforesaid case, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to the following conditions: -
